steering.name: Virtual Steering Wheel
steering.description: Sharp, responsive two-hand steering in all modes (forward, reverse, drift)

drive_forward.name: Drive / Move Forward
drive_forward.description: Both hands closed/gripping wheel automatically drives forward freely

stop_and_reverse.name: Stop / Reverse
stop_and_reverse.description: Both palms open stops the car immediately and reverses with full backward steering

drift_handbrake.name: Drift Handbrake
drift_handbrake.description: Exactly one hand closed and one hand open triggers handbrake for power drifting

nitrous.name: Nitrous Boost
nitrous.description: Thumbs up on either hand triggers Nitrous Boost (Xbox A)
